description: This Java class configures security settings for a Spring Boot application, including JWT authentication, CORS, role-based access control, and security filter chain setup.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Main security configuration class for JWT-based authentication and authorization in a Spring Boot app

methods.name: passwordEncoder
methods.description: Defines a bean for password encoding using BCrypt

methods.name: authenticationProvider
methods.description: Creates and configures a DAO authentication provider with user details service and password encoder

methods.name: authenticationManager
methods.description: Provides the AuthenticationManager bean for authentication processing

methods.name: filterChain
methods.description: Configures HTTP security, including CORS, CSRF, session management, route security, and authentication filters

methods.name: corsConfigurationSource
methods.description: Sets up CORS configuration allowing all origins, methods, and headers
